purpose: Isolate exploration persistence in shared PPO: identical gSDE initial parameters, resampling every decision versus every twelve decisions.
checkpoint_selection: First saved checkpoint at/above 50k, within one full 2560-slot rollout; retain exact live counts.
capacity_control: Same local inputs, full_std gSDE architecture, parameter count and complete initial policy tensors, including log_std.
learning_control: Each run is evaluated against its own saved zero-experience policy; paired initial behavior must be identical.
primary_contrast: For each metric: (trained - own initial) with twelve-decision resampling minus (trained - own initial) with every-decision resampling.
aggregation: One exploratory training seed. Report all paired-world effects; do not estimate across-seed variability or select only the better checkpoint.
resource_policy: One simulator worker per arm, sequential arms. Existing two coordinators remain unchanged; combined local simulator use remains below five.
limitations: One exploratory training seed, 100k live transitions and twenty reused development worlds.
This is a within-gSDE timing comparison, not a matched Gaussian-versus-gSDE algorithm comparison.
Resampling changes both heading and speed noise persistence; it does not isolate heading alone.
SB3 resamples at rollout starts as well as at the configured interval. State-dependent noise can change with observations even while its matrix is held.
The noise matrix weight std is .01, not the marginal action standard deviation.
The current input-scaling study is separate: both timing arms retain original coordinate scale and GAE lambda .95.
Fixed route/static support stays on; aircraft conflict filtering stays off.
Classical results are the preserved Windows benchmark from an earlier evaluator source.
Unseen and official streams remain reserved; no competition readiness claim.
failure_behavior: Stop this coordinator on a failed check or incomplete budget, preserve every artifact, and do not restart automatically.
initial_control: Full initial policy tensors and conditional action distributions are identical; only subsequent noise resampling differs.

noise_scale_review.interpretation: Noise matrix std is not marginal action std; input-dependent noise varies with features. These descriptive values are on a different initial seed, not performance evidence.
